create_gemma4_feature_extractor: create a Gemma4AudioFeatureExtractor with custom sampling rate, frame length, and mel filterbank parameters
extract_spectrogram_from_audio: extract a log-mel spectrogram and attention mask from a raw 1D or 2D numpy audio waveform
build_batched_mel_spectrograms: build a batch of log-mel spectrograms with padding and truncation from raw speech input
apply_preemphasis_to_frames: apply HTK-style or standard preemphasis to STFT frames extracted from audio
normalize_mel_features_per_bin: normalize log-mel spectrogram features using per-bin mean and standard deviation values
